fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects file deletion using "rm", "shred" or "unlink" commands which are used often by adversaries to delete files left behind by the actions of their intrusion activity
fields.name: File Deletion
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="linux" and (tgt.process.image.path contains "/rm" or tgt.process.image.path contains "/shred" or tgt.process.image.path contains "/unlink"))
